title: Character Variant Planner Input
description: Whole-season character-variant/twin planning request — the series' current character roster plus every drafted episode's story content. Code supplies only ground-truth facts here; this skill authors the entire variant/twin plan.

characters.description: The series' current character roster — EVERY row (base characters, existing variants, and existing twins alike). A roster entry that is itself an already-known variant or twin carries the existing_* marker fields below so you can recognize a continuation of something you've already proposed instead of re-describing it (see skill.md).

description.description: Best-effort free-text description drawn from the character's stored data (physical traits, personality, wardrobe notes). May be empty.

existing_parent_character_key.description: Set ONLY when this roster entry is ITSELF an existing variant row — the character_key of the parent character it is a variant of.

existing_variant_label.description: Companion to existing_parent_character_key — this variant row's own already-stored variant_label.

existing_shares_face_with_character_key.description: Set ONLY when this roster entry is ITSELF an existing twin row — the character_key of the face-source character it shares a face with.

episodes.description: Every drafted episode's story content for the WHOLE season (not a subset) — same StoryScriptEpisodeInput shape used by the sibling drama-script-evaluate-improve skill.

shot_drafts.description: Per-shot summary + dialogue, when this episode has been deep-drafted. Null when the episode has no shot-level draft yet.
